name: dev.socialtap/mcp
title: SocialTap
description: Social media data API for AI agents. Live data from any public link, handle or search.

tools.name: find_endpoint
tools.description: Find which SocialTap tool and endpoint serves a need ("TikTok comments", "YouTube transcript") or a link: returns the best matches with the tool and arguments to call, the price, the parameters and an example result. Use it when no tool obviously fits, or to check which platforms and links a tool takes. Free, and it works without an API key.

query.description: What you need, in plain words, or a link to a post, video or profile.

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Public posts (videos, reels, shorts, photos, carousels, tweets and text) with their author, text, media, and views, likes and comments. Pass url: its link or ID. Price per successful call: 1 credit.

platform.description: Optional: a link names its platform. Needed only for a bare ID.

url.description: A link to the item (as shared: a mobile, short or share link works) or its ID.

country.description: Only on Apple Music. Region: an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code such as US or BR (case-insensitive).

lang.description: Only on Apple Music. Preferred language: a BCP-47 tag such as en or pt-BR (case-insensitive; _ is read as -).

detail.description: concise (default) returns the fields that answer most questions, without platform_type, link_url, language, coauthors, thumbnail_url, media, mentions, is_sponsored, is_nsfw and platform_specific; full returns every field. Same price: ask for full in the first call when you need one of them.

max_age.description: Accept a cached answer up to this many seconds old; cache hits are free. Omit to always fetch live.

max_credits.description: The most this request may be charged, in credits. One that would cost more stops first, free, with insufficient_credits (details.reason max_credits). Omit for the endpoint's price, up to its maximum.

cursor.description: next_cursor from this tool's previous result: the rest of a cut result. Send the same other arguments.

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: The posts of a profile, a page per call: public posts (videos, reels, shorts, photos, carousels, tweets and text) with their author, text, media, and views, likes and comments. Pass handle: a profile link, @handle, username or ID. Price per successful page: Bluesky, Facebook, Instagram, Kwai, Reddit, Rumble, Threads, TikTok, Truth Social, X, YouTube: 1 credit. LinkedIn: 1 credit (public page) or 10 credits (data partner). Follow next_cursor while it is set; a short page is not the end.

platform.description: Optional with a profile link, which names it; needed with a bare username or ID.

handle.description: A profile link, @handle, username or ID.

tab.description: Only on Bluesky, Rumble or YouTube. Bluesky: The profile tab to list. Rumble: The tab to list. YouTube: The channel tab to list.

since.description: Only items at or after this time: RFC 3339 (2026-10-01T12:00:00Z) or a date (2026-10-01, midnight UTC).

until.description: Only items before this time (exclusive): RFC 3339 or a date (midnight UTC).

media.description: Only on LinkedIn or X. LinkedIn: Only posts of one kind. X: Only the account's own posts, no reposts, with media: any (a photo, video or GIF), image (photos) or video (a video or GIF).

sort.description: Only on Reddit, Rumble, X or YouTube. Order of the results.

duration.description: Only on Rumble. Only short videos (Rumble's Under 4 minutes) or long ones (Over 20 minutes).

limit.description: Items per page, up to the endpoint's page size (the default; larger values are reduced to it). Omit it for the cheapest walk: a page costs the same whatever its limit.

detail.description: concise (default) returns the fields that answer most questions, without platform_type, link_url, language, coauthors, thumbnail_url, media, mentions, is_sponsored, is_nsfw and platform_specific; full returns every field. Same price: ask for full in the first call when you need one of them.

max_age.description: Accept a cached answer up to this many seconds old; cache hits are free. Omit to always fetch live.

max_credits.description: The most this request may be charged, in credits. One that would cost more stops first, free, with insufficient_credits (details.reason max_credits). Omit for the endpoint's price, up to its maximum.

cursor.description: next_cursor from this tool's previous result: the next page, or the rest of a cut result. Send the same other arguments.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Public accounts (creators, channels, pages, companies, communities) with their bio, links, and follower and post counts. Pass handle: a profile link, @handle, username or ID. Price per successful call: Apple Music, Bluesky, Facebook, GitHub, Google, Hacker News, Instagram, Komi, Kwai, Lnk.Bio, Linkme, Linktree, Pillar, Pinterest, Reddit, Rumble, Snapchat, SoundCloud, Spotify, Telegram, Threads, TikTok, Truth Social, Twitch, X, YouTube: 1 credit. LinkedIn: 1 credit (public page or web search) or 5 credits (data partner).

platform.description: Optional with a profile link, which names it; needed with a bare username or ID.

handle.description: A profile link, @handle, username or ID.

country.description: Only on Apple Music or Google. Region: an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code such as US or BR (case-insensitive).

lang.description: Only on Apple Music. Preferred language: a BCP-47 tag such as en or pt-BR (case-insensitive; _ is read as -).

detail.description: concise (default) returns the fields that answer most questions, without avatar_url, banner_url, country_code and platform_specific; full returns every field. Same price: ask for full in the first call when you need one of them.

max_age.description: Accept a cached answer up to this many seconds old; cache hits are free. Omit to always fetch live.

max_credits.description: The most this request may be charged, in credits. One that would cost more stops first, free, with insufficient_credits (details.reason max_credits). Omit for the endpoint's price, up to its maximum.

cursor.description: next_cursor from this tool's previous result: the rest of a cut result. Send the same other arguments.

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: The comments of a post, a page per call: public comments and replies with their author, text, place in the thread, and like and reply counts. Pass url: its link or ID. Price per successful page: Bluesky, Facebook, Hacker News, Instagram, Reddit, Rumble, Snapchat, Threads, TikTok, X, YouTube: 1 credit. LinkedIn: 1 credit (public page) or 5 credits (data partner). Follow next_cursor while it is set; a short page is not the end.

platform.description: Optional: a link names its platform. Needed only for a bare ID.

url.description: A link to the item (as shared: a mobile, short or share link works) or its ID.

sort.description: Only on Bluesky, Facebook, Hacker News, Reddit, Rumble or YouTube. Order of the results.

since.description: Only on Bluesky, Facebook, Hacker News, Instagram, Reddit, Rumble, Snapchat, Threads, TikTok, X or YouTube. Only items at or after this time: RFC 3339 (2026-10-01T12:00:00Z) or a date (2026-10-01, midnight UTC).

until.description: Only on Bluesky, Facebook, Hacker News, Instagram, Reddit, Rumble, Snapchat, Threads, TikTok, X or YouTube. Only items before this time (exclusive): RFC 3339 or a date (midnight UTC).

replies.description: Only on Reddit. all: the whole tree, with the replies Reddit holds behind "more replies" links on the next pages, so a walk costs several times the pages.

comment_id.description: Only on Snapchat. List this comment's replies instead: the id of a comment from this endpoint.

limit.description: Items per page, up to the endpoint's page size (the default; larger values are reduced to it). Omit it for the cheapest walk: a page costs the same whatever its limit.

detail.description: concise (default) returns the fields that answer most questions, without platform, post_id, url, edited_at, is_edited, is_liked_by_author and is_by_post_author; full returns every field. Same price: ask for full in the first call when you need one of them.

max_age.description: Accept a cached answer up to this many seconds old; cache hits are free. Omit to always fetch live.

max_credits.description: The most this request may be charged, in credits. One that would cost more stops first, free, with insufficient_credits (details.reason max_credits). Omit for the endpoint's price, up to its maximum.

cursor.description: next_cursor from this tool's previous result: the next page, or the rest of a cut result. Send the same other arguments.

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: Timed transcripts of public videos: the platform's caption track, or speech-to-text on the audio when there is none. Pass url: its link or ID. Price per successful call: Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Reddit, Rumble, TikTok, X, YouTube: 1 credit (captions) or 2 credits + 2 per started minute of media (speech-to-text, automatic up to 3 minutes, longer with transcribe_audio=true). Kick, Twitch: 2 credits + 2 per started minute of media (speech-to-text, automatic up to 3 minutes, longer with transcribe_audio=true).

platform.description: Optional: a link names its platform. Needed only for a bare ID.

url.description: A link to the item (as shared: a mobile, short or share link works) or its ID.

transcribe_audio.description: Speech-to-text for media without captions, at the speech-to-text price.

lang.description: Only on Kick, Reddit, Rumble, TikTok, Twitch, X or YouTube. Preferred language: a BCP-47 tag such as en or pt-BR (case-insensitive; _ is read as -).

detail.description: concise (default) returns the fields that answer most questions, without segments and platform_specific; full returns every field. Same price: ask for full in the first call when you need one of them.

max_age.description: Accept a cached answer up to this many seconds old; cache hits are free. Omit to always fetch live.

max_credits.description: The most this request may be charged, in credits. One that would cost more stops first, free, with insufficient_credits (details.reason max_credits). Omit for the endpoint's price, up to its maximum.

cursor.description: next_cursor from this tool's previous result: the rest of a cut result. Send the same other arguments.

tools.name: get_engagement
tools.description: Engagement rate, average views, likes and comments, posting cadence and top post of an account, computed from recent posts the same way on every platform. Pass handle: a profile link, @handle, username or ID. Price per successful call: Facebook, Instagram, Reddit, Rumble, TikTok, X, YouTube: 1 credit. LinkedIn: 1 credit (public page) or 15 credits (data partner).

platform.description: Optional with a profile link, which names it; needed with a bare username or ID.

handle.description: A profile link, @handle, username or ID.

tab.description: Only on Rumble or YouTube. Rumble: The tab whose uploads the figures cover. YouTube: The uploads the figures cover: the channel's latest videos or its latest shorts.

detail.description: concise (default) returns the fields that answer most questions, without bottom_post_id and platform_specific; full returns every field. Same price: ask for full in the first call when you need one of them.

max_age.description: Accept a cached answer up to this many seconds old; cache hits are free. Omit to always fetch live.

max_credits.description: The most this request may be charged, in credits. One that would cost more stops first, free, with insufficient_credits (details.reason max_credits). Omit for the endpoint's price, up to its maximum.

cursor.description: next_cursor from this tool's previous result: the rest of a cut result. Send the same other arguments.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search a platform by query for ads, advertisers, albums, channels, comments, communities, events, groups, hashtags, issues, jobs, places, playlists, podcasts, posts, products, profiles, repositories, sounds, suggestions or top. Pass platform, type and query. Types by platform: amazon: products; applemusic: albums, profiles, playlists, posts; bluesky: posts; facebook: ads, advertisers, events, groups, products, places, posts, profiles; github: issues, profiles, repositories; google: ads, profiles, suggestions; hackernews: comments, posts; instagram: hashtags, places, posts, profiles, sounds, suggestions; linkedin: ads, jobs, posts, profiles; pinterest: posts; reddit: comments, posts, profiles, communities; rumble: posts; spotify: albums, profiles, playlists, podcasts, posts; telegram: channels; threads: posts, profiles; tiktok: ads, hashtags, posts, profiles, sounds, suggestions, top; tiktokshop: products; x: communities, hashtags, posts, profiles; youtube: posts, profiles, suggestions. Price per successful page: Amazon, Apple Music, Bluesky, GitHub, Google, Hacker News, Instagram, Pinterest, Reddit, Rumble, Spotify, Threads, TikTok Shop, YouTube: 1 credit. Facebook, LinkedIn, Telegram, TikTok, X: 1 credit + 1 per result filled in (with fill=true). Follow next_cursor while it is set; a short page is not the end. It also takes each platform's own filters (such as kind or author), not listed here: find_endpoint's params name them for each search.

type.description: What to search for. Each platform searches some types (the tool's description lists them).

country.description: Only on some platforms (find_endpoint lists which). Region: an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code such as US or BR (case-insensitive).

sort.description: Only on some platforms (find_endpoint lists which). Order of the results.

lang.description: Only for Apple Music (every type), Bluesky posts, Facebook ads, Spotify (every type), YouTube suggestions. Preferred language: a BCP-47 tag such as en or pt-BR (case-insensitive; _ is read as -).

since.description: Only on some platforms (find_endpoint lists which). Only items at or after this time: RFC 3339 (2026-10-01T12:00:00Z) or a date (2026-10-01, midnight UTC).

until.description: Only on some platforms (find_endpoint lists which). Only items before this time (exclusive): RFC 3339 or a date (midnight UTC).

status.description: Only for Facebook ads, GitHub issues, TikTok ads. Only active items, only inactive ones, or both (all).

fill.description: Only on some platforms (find_endpoint lists which). true also fetches each result's full, current record from the platform into details (exact counts, its ID).

period.description: Only for Facebook products, LinkedIn jobs. The time window, in days back from the platform's latest update; each endpoint lists its values.

limit.description: Items per page, up to the endpoint's page size (the default; larger values are reduced to it). Omit it for the cheapest walk: a page costs the same whatever its limit.

detail.description: concise (default) returns the fields that answer most questions; full returns every field. Same price.

max_age.description: Accept a cached answer up to this many seconds old; cache hits are free. Omit to always fetch live.

max_credits.description: The most this request may be charged, in credits. One that would cost more stops first, free, with insufficient_credits (details.reason max_credits). Omit for the endpoint's price, up to its maximum.

cursor.description: next_cursor from this tool's previous result: the next page, or the rest of a cut result. Send the same other arguments.

tools.name: call_endpoint
tools.description: Call any endpoint by the ID find_endpoint gives (tiktok.sound_posts), with the arguments it gives: the data the other tools here don't cover. Same price, results and cursors as the endpoint's own tool.

arguments.description: Its arguments, as find_endpoint gives them (url, handle or query, its params, detail, cursor); platform and type come from the endpoint.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the SocialTap docs (guides, the API reference, error codes, schemas, pricing) for a question or term: returns the best-matching sections with their page, a snippet and the path to read with read_doc. Use it before writing integration code. Free, and it works without an API key.

query.description: What to look up: a question, an error code, a parameter or field name.

tools.name: read_doc
tools.description: Read one SocialTap docs page as Markdown: a path from search_docs or llms.txt (/docs/pagination/), or a full docs URL. A page longer than about 20,000 tokens comes in parts: call again with cursor=next_cursor for the rest. Free, and it works without an API key.

path.description: The page: its path on the docs site (/docs/errors/) or its URL, with or without index.md.

cursor.description: Where to continue a long page: a previous result's next_cursor.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Get the account, balance and calling key. Returns the account: its balance, plan and settings, and the key that made the call, with its scopes, spend limit and expiry. Never cached. Use it to check the credit balance before a large task; every other result already states credits_remaining. It also says how your user buys credits.

detail.description: concise (default) returns the fields an agent acts on; full returns every field, the account's settings included.

tools.name: buy_credits
tools.description: Buy a credit pack (Stripe Checkout). Creates a Stripe Checkout session for a credit pack; open the returned url to pay. Credits are added when payment completes; GET /v1/billing/checkout/{id} follows it. Use it when your user wants more credits or a call answered insufficient_credits: give them the url, which opens Stripe Checkout in their browser. Nothing is charged until they pay there, and the credits are added when they do. Ask them which pack first.

pack.description: Pack ID: 1k (1,000 credits, $14.00), 30k (30,000 credits, $59.00), 250k (250,000 credits, $379.00), 2m (2,000,000 credits, $1,499.00), starter_topup (5,000 credits, $14.00, for subscribers of the starter plan only), growth_topup (10,000 credits, $18.00, for subscribers of the growth plan only), scale_topup (15,000 credits, $25.00, for subscribers of the scale plan only).

idempotency_key.description: Makes a retry safe: the same key with the same arguments returns the first call's result (its current state), never runs it twice. Default: derived from the other arguments, so an identical retry is already safe; pass a new value to run the same arguments again.
